IMPERIAL TELEGRAPH WIRETAP LOG - SAURIA RELAY
TIGRAYAN RECONNAISSANCE DETACHMENT
COORDINATED WITH RAS ALULA ENGIDA
NIGHT OF 29 YEKATIT 1888 (29 FEBRUARY 1896)
SESSION IDENTIFIER: tigray_wiretap_scout
===============================================================================

WIRETAP OVERVIEW:
Scout wiremen tapped the Italian military telegraph copper wire between
Sauria forward headquarters and the coastal garrison at Massawa.

TECHNICAL CAPTURE:
- Target File   : intercept.pcap
- Protocol      : IMTP/1.0 on TCP port 1896
- Source IPs    : Multiple Italian military nodes
- Key IPs       :
    192.168.18.10  Baratieri Forward HQ
    192.168.18.96  Sauria Telegraph Relay
    192.168.18.4   Massawa Coastal HQ
    192.168.18.1   Asmara Command Post

SWITCHBOARD CALIBRATION:
Relay station switchboard physical key:
PHYSICAL_KEY = "SAURIA_1896"

DISPATCH OVERVIEW:
Captured traffic contains routine brigade communications alongside encoded
telegrams from the Italian Cipher Bureau. Piece together what was transmitted
across the wire to recover General Baratieri's midnight orders.
